draft.question: I've won the World Cup, the Champions League and the Ballon d'Or. Incredibly, I'm the first defensive midfielder to receive that individual award since 1990. I've played with the likes of Guardiola at City before moving to Barcelona

evidenceText: Combining his international success with City's achievements, Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or, becoming the first defensive midfielder since Lothar Matthäus in 1990 to receive the award, as well as the second Spanish player and the first City player to do so.

claims.text: I've played with the likes of Guardiola at City
evidenceText: His performances earned him interest from then-Manchester City manager and compatriot Pep Guardiola.
At City, Rodri developed into a centrepiece of Guardiola's team.
He played a decisive role in the club's domestic dominance, winning four consecutive Premier League titles and completing the continental treble in 2022–23.
On 18 August 2026, Rodri signed for La Liga club Barcelona on a four-year contract.
